name: V-2500 Vinyl Double Pane Annealed New Construction Single Hung Window
description: JELD-WEN V-2500 vinyl windows combine beauty performance and affordability. Window unit has an almond exterior and matching interior and lock. Built from low maintenance high quality extruded vinyl that does not chip or peel and resists fading mildew and condensation. Single-hung tilt window features internal factory sealed grids and a tilt-in bottom sash for easy cleaning. Slamming your windows shut is a thing of the past with the block and tackle balance system. Fusion-welded frame provides reliable structural performance. Includes matching fiberglass mesh screen to protect again insects. Window is ENERGY STAR certified in all energy zones. Each JELD-WEN window is built to last and we prove this by supporting each window with a lifetime limited warranty for peace of mind.
